Plugin button styles

Three parallel editors demonstrate the button styles supported by the example plugins via buttonStyle:

  • buttonStyle: 'svg' — compact SVG icon buttons that match the built-in toolbar.
  • buttonStyle: 'text' — compact uppercase labels, same height and padding as the SVG variant.
  • buttonStyle: 'glyph' — emoji / Greek glyph used as the button content (opt-in for emoji picker and special characters).
SVG icon style buttonStyle: 'svg'

Example configuration - Plugin Button Styles
summernote.create('#plugin-button-styles-svg', {
  height: 220,
  buttonStyle: 'svg',
  toolbar: [
    ['style', ['style']],
    ['font', ['bold', 'underline', 'clear']],
    ['plugins-paragraph', ['alignLeft', 'alignCenter', 'alignRight', 'alignJustify']],
    ['plugins-text', ['markText', 'inlineCode', 'kbdText', 'varText', 'sampleText']],
    ['plugins-insert', ['specialCharacters', 'emojiPicker']],
    ['plugins-tools', ['wordCounterToggle', 'linkExtractorToggle']],
  ],
});
